data.one_liner: Utility library for Atsign Protocol projects with atSign helpers and logging.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility classes and functions for Atsign Protocol projects. It includes helpers for atSigns, atmetadata, configuration, and a customizable logging system.
use_when: You are building apps using the Atsign protocol and need atSign parsing or validation.
You need standard logging handlers tailored for CLI or general logging within the Atsign ecosystem.
avoid_when: You are building a standard application unrelated to the Atsign ecosystem.
You only need general-purpose Dart utility helpers already covered by core libraries.
strengths: Tailored specifically for Atsign protocol conventions and atSign string handling.
Browser-friendly core exports in version 4.0.0 since dart:io features are separated into at_utils_io.dart.
weaknesses: Very niche scope restricted to Atsign projects.
Breaking changes between major versions require code adjustments when upgrading.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import at_utils or at_utils_io as needed.
